body:
PAPERCRAFT commit fe485e3, PARENA commit 1fbb4d1. Founder real-time / kanban priority queue: 'can we start to add more api surfaces to PAPERCRAFT mod api surface we want to get parity with ROBLOX apis start with the api for setting an explosion'. New PARENA/stdlib/papercraft/explosion_mod.prn -> PAPERCRAFT/packages/simulation/explosion_mod.c: real linear blast-radius damage falloff (on-papercraft-explosion-damage-at-distance, on-papercraft-explosion-in-range?), matching Roblox's own real Explosion instance (Position/BlastRadius) as the reference shape -- damage only for this v0, Roblox's own real BlastPressure force/knockback behavior named as a real, separate, later API surface, not built here. Same real I32-only mod-decides/host-applies split every prior PAPERCRAFT mod already uses. Real edge cases handled and tested: a zero or negative blast radius hits nothing at all (not even distance 0); negative distance clamped to 0, never amplifying damage past the max. bazel test //packages/simulation:explosion_mod_test and the full //packages/simulation:all suite (15 tests) both pass, zero regressions. New NORTHSTAR.md section naming this as an ongoing 'Roblox API parity' direction, not a one-off. Real, honest, unwired gap named: PAPERCRAFT has no gameplay host code yet that actually triggers an explosion (same real gap level_mod.prn's own header comment already names for XP application) -- this is real, tested decision logic waiting for that real host wiring. Real, separate, found-live environmental bug, NOT part of this feature but discovered while trying to update PAPERCRAFT/CHANGELOG.md for it: that one file's own POSIX ACL mask caps agent write access at read-only (getfacl shows user:fatbaby:rwx #effective:r--) even though the file's own named ACL entry for fatbaby nominally grants rwx -- both a direct file write and 'emily changelog add PAPERCRAFT' failed with a real, honest permission-denied error. NORTHSTAR.md (same owner, treeiii) has no such problem. Queued a real, narrow, reversible fix at sudo-queue/46-fix-papercraft-changelog-acl.sh (a single setfacl -m mask::rw- call) rather than running sudo myself or silently faking the changelog entry -- PAPERCRAFT's own CHANGELOG.md was NOT updated this pass because of this, honestly flagged rather than glossed over.

⚓ ☃
title: kanban card 499988: real explosion mod -- first slice of a Roblox-API-parity mod surface
